scenes.conflict: Tamsin's self-reliance makes her reluctant to show uncertain work, while Elin's protectiveness keeps the archive's gaps unspoken.
scenes.goal: Identify when and how the unfamiliar mark was added to the chart.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin confirms the mark is recent but cannot explain it; Elin's hesitation leaves her to investigate alone.
scenes.summary: While comparing the observatory charts, Tamsin finds a fresh mark on an old map that she did not draw. Elin recognizes that its ink sits above a layer tied to the disputed founding account, but withholds her interpretation.
scenes.title: A Mark in the Layers

scenes.conflict: Tamsin wants to verify the evidence before sharing it, but Mira's urgency makes delay feel dangerous.
scenes.goal: Determine whether the new map mark corresponds to a real shift in the islands.
scenes.outcome: The shadow shift and missing note confirm the bridge is failing; Tamsin agrees to inspect the span with Mira.
scenes.summary: Tamsin tracks the neighboring islands' shadows and discovers that the span toward Cinderwake no longer matches the old chart. Mira arrives from Morrowmere with news that the bridge's familiar note has vanished.
scenes.title: The Shadow Out of Place

scenes.conflict: Oren trusts the measurable repair, while Mira and Tamsin see the missing note and map evidence as signs of a deeper failure.
scenes.goal: Stabilize the span long enough to make passage safe for further investigation.
scenes.outcome: The brace buys time but cannot restore alignment, proving that a mechanical fix alone is insufficient.
scenes.summary: At the Morrowmere approach, Oren diagnoses the wandering span and fits a crystal brace. It slows the movement, but the missing note does not return, and the bridge remains out of alignment.
scenes.title: A Brace Cannot Sing

scenes.conflict: Sella fears losing the Compact's leverage, and Mira interprets her guarded offer as another refusal to cooperate.
scenes.goal: Gain access to the old route so the enclaves can reconnect their bridge approaches.
scenes.outcome: Sella reveals enough of the route to show it passes through Cinderwake, but withholds the ledger history that explains how the Compact got it.
scenes.summary: Mira and Tamsin travel to Liltmarket to find the old route linking the bridge approaches. Sella admits the Tideledger Compact holds a private copy, but offers access only if the group accepts her terms.
scenes.title: A Path Through the Ledger

scenes.conflict: Sella's selective disclosure undermines trust, while Tamsin's wish for certainty delays a decision about what the evidence means.
scenes.goal: Establish whether the route can reconnect the communities and what history it conceals.
scenes.outcome: Sella realizes the route's value depends on the very history she has kept hidden and agrees to bring its private copy to Aevenreach.
scenes.summary: Tamsin compares Sella's route with her chart layers, while Mira listens for the direction of the broken bridge chorus. The discrepancies point to a removed island name and an altered route entry.
scenes.title: The Cost of the Copy

scenes.conflict: Elin fears the archive will lose credibility if its omissions are exposed, and Sella knows the ledger implicates her own circle.
scenes.goal: Compare the private route with the founding account and identify what the revision erased.
scenes.outcome: Elin acknowledges the altered record and Sella offers the route history with it; together they identify the need for every enclave to recognize the full account.
scenes.summary: Back in Aevenreach, Sella presents the route beside the Inkwardens' layered charts. Elin identifies the altered founding account: an island's name was removed during the Silent Revision, leaving the bridges with an incomplete shared memory.
scenes.title: The Name Removed

scenes.conflict: Tamsin fears her incomplete map will make her unreliable, and Oren resists conclusions that depend on a disputed history.
scenes.goal: Test whether the combined chart, route, and bridge readings can guide a safe attempt to restore alignment.
scenes.outcome: The measurements support Tamsin's shifting-position chart, but the bridge can only be tested if the linked communities answer together.
scenes.summary: Tamsin presents her uncertain chart to Oren and Mira instead of polishing it in secret. Oren checks the predicted span movement against the brace's strain, while Mira matches the route's direction to the missing tone.
scenes.title: A Chart Shared Before It Is Finished

scenes.conflict: The evidence exposes each enclave's part in the division, and Tamsin's fear of uncertainty tempts her to retreat to a single polished chart.
scenes.goal: Build a mutually acknowledged account of the islands' former positions before the failing span wanders further.
scenes.outcome: The group agrees on a shared account that includes the removed name and the route's disputed history, and commits to test it at the bridge.
scenes.summary: At Liltmarket, Tamsin asks the representatives to lay their charts, route entries, and recollections side by side. Sella discloses the private ledger copy and its history; Elin names the Inkwardens' omission rather than presenting their account as complete.
scenes.title: Every Version at the Table

scenes.conflict: The span continues to wander despite the brace, and Oren must trust a shared account while Mira must resist rushing the chorus.
scenes.goal: Keep the bridge stable long enough for the communities to answer its notes together.
scenes.outcome: The brace slows the drift at the predicted joint, creating a brief safe interval for the shared measure.
scenes.summary: At the Cinderwake span, Oren refits his crystal brace where the joint is under greatest strain. He relies on the shared chart to anticipate the movement, while Mira waits to sound the chorus until the repair is secure.
scenes.title: The Brace Holds

scenes.conflict: The voices begin unevenly, and the bridge's note remains faint; Mira fears discord means refusal, while Tamsin must accept that the account need not be perfect to be shared.
scenes.goal: Restore the bridge's alignment by having the linked communities acknowledge the same account of their past positions.
scenes.outcome: The communities sustain the sequence together. The missing note returns, and the bridge settles into alignment while Oren's brace supports the span.
scenes.summary: Using the disclosed route, Tamsin guides the group through the sequence of former island positions. Mira listens for the missing note and invites each community's answering tone; Oren monitors the braced span as its wandering slows.
scenes.title: The Bridge Remembers

scenes.conflict: Elin must accept that exposing the archive's limits is part of preserving it, while Sella must give up the influence she gained by keeping the route private.
scenes.goal: Preserve the account in a form every enclave can consult and correct together.
scenes.outcome: The public chart includes the disputed history and the route, giving the enclaves a common record instead of a single guarded version.
scenes.summary: The enclaves bring the shared account back to Aevenreach, where Elin records both the confirmed positions and the uncertainties. Sella adds the route's ledger history, ending the Compact's exclusive hold over the copy.
scenes.title: The Open Chart

scenes.conflict: The repair is not permanent, and each character must resist treating their own practice as a complete solution.
scenes.goal: Confirm that the bridge remains aligned and establish how the enclaves will notice future strain.
scenes.outcome: The bridge holds as the communities share its notes and measurements; Tamsin begins charting with others rather than waiting for solitary certainty.
scenes.summary: At Morrowmere, Mira leads a new listening along the restored span while Oren checks the brace and Tamsin compares its position with the open chart. The bridge answers clearly, though the group knows it will need continued care.
scenes.title: A Note Answered

logline: When the skybridges of Velisara begin to wander, young cartographer Tamsin Vale must unite rival enclaves around a disputed history before the islands drift beyond reach.
theme: A shared truth can hold a divided world together.
title: The Skybridge Chronicles
